acceptanceCriteria: One named consumer withholds credit on blocksCredit with a test.
An external profile revision (or a recorded decision not to) lets profiled receipts carry the record.
The over-blocking trade-off is recorded in the spec.
body: Found 2026-10-18 by the V1-1737 lane (PR beamfall/corvint#1101, head d102a537a, LPCV-V0-080..083). Expected: an ANCHOR-FAILED verdict with blocksCredit=true withholds witness credit in a consumer (doccorpus witnesses, CEM verification evidence). Actual: blocksCredit is only reported; profiled receipts (including the doccorpus witnesses) refuse the record with external-profile-has-request-outcomes until an external profile revision. Also note over-blocking by design: an unrelated failure of the positive sibling blocks credit.
title: test-validity: no consumer reads rejectionAnchor.blocksCredit; profiled receipts cannot carry request-outcomes
